title: VP Operations
description:
**Job Description –Head of Operations (Medical AI Diagnostics)**

**Location:** Gurgaon

**Experience:** 10\+ Years

**About ImagingIQ**

ImagingIQ is an AI\-powered Medical Imaging and Diagnostics company focused on transforming radiology through explainable, clinically validated, and scalable AI solutions. Our platform combines advanced Computer Vision, Deep Learning, and Generative AI to assist radiologists in delivering faster, more accurate, and consistent diagnoses while seamlessly integrating with existing healthcare ecosystems. We are expanding globally and are seeking visionary leaders to help build the future of AI\-driven diagnostics across India, US and international healthcare markets.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a seasoned executive to lead the operational strategy and global growth of our AI\-powered Medical Imaging business. Reporting directly to the CEO / Founder, the Vice President / Head of Operations will drive operational excellence, enterprise customer success, strategic partnerships, and international expansion, with a strong focus on the US and global healthcare markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Define and execute the company’s global operations strategy, aligned with business growth and international expansion.

· Lead enterprise implementations and customer success across hospitals, diagnostic chains, teleradiology providers, imaging centers, and healthcare networks.

· Build and scale high\-performing teams across Operations, Clinical Delivery, Customer Success, Technical Support, and Program Management.

· Develop strategic channel partnerships with PACS/RIS vendors, OEMs, healthcare technology companies, system integrators, cloud partners, and value\-added resellers.

· Establish and nurture relationships with global radiology groups, academic medical centers, diagnostic networks, teleradiology organizations, and healthcare associations to accelerate market adoption.

· Drive business expansion in the **US healthcare market**, with a strong understanding of provider workflows, reimbursement models, regulatory requirements, enterprise procurement, and healthcare partnerships.

· Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Clinical Affairs, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to ensure successful product deployment and customer outcomes.

· Establish governance, operational KPIs, quality frameworks, SLAs, and continuous improvement initiatives.

· Support regulatory readiness, clinical validation programs, and commercialization across international markets.

**Qualifications**

· 10 \+ years of leadership experience in Healthcare, Medical Imaging, Diagnostics, or HealthTech.

**Strategic \& Technical Expertise**

· Proven success in scaling operations and commercial delivery for medical imaging, radiology informatics, diagnostics, or AI healthcare businesses.

· Strong experience in the US healthcare ecosystem, including hospitals, imaging centers, provider networks, teleradiology organizations, or healthcare technology companies.

· Strong understanding of AI/ML in Radiology and Medical Imaging, including Computer Vision, Generative AI, LLMs, and AI model lifecycle.

· Experience with AI\-enabled diagnostic solutions, clinical validation, and integration with PACS, RIS, DICOM, HL7/FHIR, and enterprise healthcare systems.

· Proven leadership in scaling operations and commercial delivery for Medical Imaging, Radiology Informatics, Diagnostics, or AI Healthcare businesses.

· Deep understanding of radiology workflows, healthcare IT, and AI\-based Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).

· Experience in positioning and deploying AI\-powered imaging solutions integrated with **PACS, RIS, DICOM, HL7/FHIR**, cloud platforms, and enterprise healthcare systems.

· Demonstrated success in building global channel partnerships, strategic alliances, and relationships within the international radiology and healthcare ecosystem.

· Ability to collaborate effectively with AI Scientists, Clinical Researchers, Product Management, and Engineering teams to translate AI innovations into scalable commercial solutions.

Pay: From ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gurugram, Haryana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 10\+ years of relevant professional experience, with significant leadership experience in healthcare / healthtech?
* Do you have strong experience in healthcare operations, business leadership, delivery, implementation, or transformation?
* Do you have experience specifically in medical imaging, radiology, diagnostics, or healthcare technology?
* Have you worked with AI\-enabled healthcare products, digital health solutions, PACS/RIS, DICOM, or related clinical technology ecosystems?
* Have you managed enterprise healthcare customers, hospitals, diagnostic centres, or healthcare delivery networks, particularly within the US healthcare ecosystem?
* Have you led cross\-functional teams involving technology/product, clinical, business, customer\-facing, and operations functions, with responsibility for scaling and measurable business outcomes?

Experience:

* healthcare / healthtech: 10 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: SAP Project & Operations Lead
description:
**Purpose of Position:**

The SAP Project \& Operations Lead serves as the primary functional focal point across Project System (PS), Plant Maintenance (PM), Production Planning (PP), and Quality Management (QM) within the Group\-wide SAP S/4HANA environment

The role ensures stable operational processes, supports continuous improvement, leads solution design, and enables best\-practice process adoption across all operating companies.

This position serves as the primary functional authority for operations\-related modules and works closely with business stakeholders, SAP partners, and internal CoE teams to ensure efficient and reliable SAP\-enabled business processes.

The role also provides leadership, mentoring and functional direction to Associate Consultants and contributes to the long\-term enhancement and standardization of SAP operations processes across the Group.

**Key Responsibilities \& Accountabilities:**

**SAP Functional Ownership**

1\. Lead functional ownership of PM, PS, PP, and QM modules across the SAP S/4HANA Group instance.

2\. Manage solution architecture and ensure alignment to SAP best practices and business process standards.

3\. Lead Fit\-to\-Standard, solution design, configuration review, and functional specification development.

**Operational Excellence \& Support**

4\. Ensure stable system operations, manage L2/L3 incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and resolve cross\-functional issues.

5\. Oversee the associate’s daily support work, ensuring timely resolution of operational tickets and adherence to CoE processes.

6\. Monitor integration touchpoints with MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, EHS, and SCM to maintain data and process consistency.

**Enhancements, Change Management, and Optimization**

7\. Identify and lead enhancement initiatives across PM, PS, PP, and QM to improve performance, usability, and compliance.

8\. Develop functional specifications, coordinate with technical teams (ABAP, BTP, Integration), and validate delivered solutions.

9\. Lead the testing lifecycle (SIT/UAT), including developing test scripts, validating results, and ensuring quality assurance.

**Business Engagement \& Governance**

10\. Collaborate with business owners (Operations, Engineering, Projects, Manufacturing, HSE, QA) to analyse pain points and improvement opportunities.

11\. Define and maintain process documentation, SOPs, functional specifications, solution documentation, and training materials.

12\. Ensure compliance with audit requirements, internal controls, change management processes, and system governance.

**Reporting \& Analytics Alignment**

13\. Work closely with the SAP Analytics \& Reporting Consultant to support operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for operations functions.

14\. Validate data accuracy for operational KPIs across PP, PM, PS, and QM.

**Leadership \& CoE Development**

15\. Guide and mentor the Associate Consultants assigned to operations modules.

16\. Contribute to SAP roadmap discussions and future CoE capability development.

17\. Represent the operations domain in Group SAP governance forums (SteerCo, Change Advisory Board, etc.)

**Principal Challenges:**

1\. Managing complex integration across PM, PS, PP, and QM within a single SAP instance used by multiple companies across the group.

2\. Balancing heavy operational support with enhancement demands and strategic improvement initiatives.

3\. Standardizing processes across operating companies with varying maturity levels.

4\. Ensuring strong change control and avoiding disruption to mission\-critical operations.

5\. Managing cross\-functional dependencies and ensuring alignment between technical and functional teams.

**Minimum Academic \& Professional Qualifications**:

1\. Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Operations Management, or an equivalent field.

2\. SAP S/4HANA certification in PM, PP, or PS is required (multiple certifications are advantageous).

3\. Proven experience with SAP Activate methodology, including fit\-to\-standard analysis, testing cycles, and deployment phases, is required

4\. Strong understanding of manufacturing, maintenance, project management, and quality process cycles.

5\. Additional certifications or learning in process architecture, or solution governance is an advantage

**Minimum Work Experience:** 

1\. 7 to 10 years of hands\-on experience delivering and supporting SAP PM, PS, PP, and QM modules.

2\. Proven experience leading solution design, configuration oversight, testing, and deployment in at least two full\-cycle SAP implementations or major rollout projects (S/4HANA preferred).

3\. Strong track record in stabilizing operations, resolving cross\-module issues, and improving system performance.

4\. Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders and managing functional expectations.

5\. Prior experience guiding junior consultants or support analysts is strongly preferred.

6\. Exposure to SAP BTP integrations, Fiori apps, digital maintenance, and manufacturing execution systems is a plus.

**Skills \& Competencies Required:**

· **Technical \& Functional Skills**

1\. Deep functional expertise in PM, PS, PP, and QM with proven configuration and solution design knowledge.

2\. Strong understanding of cross\-functional processes (MM, FICO, HR, Procurement, and SCM).

3\. Proficiency in defining functional specifications, validating technical development, and coordinating with technical teams.

4\. Strong understanding of S/4HANA master data (materials, equipment, BOM, routing, WBS, work centers).

5\. Experience in troubleshooting performance, integration, and data integrity issues.

6\. Familiarity with process automation, workflow, and enhancement frameworks.

7\. Knowledge of SAP role/authorization framework for operational areas.

· **Soft Skills**

1\. Strong leadership qualities with the ability to mentor and guide an associate.

2\. Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage senior stakeholders.

3\. Highly analytical and structured problem\-solving ability.

4\. Strong documentation, process mapping, and presentation skills.

5\. Ability to manage multiple workstreams and prioritize under pressure.

6\. High level of accountability and ownership of module performance.

7\. Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to adopt new SAP innovations.

8\. Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break down complex SAP issues.

**QHSSE Responsibilities:**

1\. Comply with all organizational Quality, Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (QHSSE) policies and procedures.

2\. Ensure that all SAP support activities follow documented quality standards and audit requirements.

3\. Proactively identify and report any risks or non\-compliances that may impact system integrity or business operations.

4\. Maintain secure handling of system access, data privacy, and sensitive business information.

5\. Promote a safe and compliant working environment through accountability, awareness, and continuous improvement.

Job Types: Full\-time, Contractual / Temporary

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Gurugram, Haryana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* SAP Experience

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* SAP : 5 years (Required)

title: Project Management (Central Operations) - Gurugram (Contractual)
description:
**City:** Gurugram  

**Department:** Operations


**Recruiter:** Tanu Jagnani

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.



Join FlixBus India and play a key role in expanding one of India's fastest\-growing intercity mobility networks. As part of the Project Associate \- Operations team, you will drive the execution and closure of compliance initiatives across all operating regions. You will be the central coordination point between Safety, Fleet Coordinators (FCs), Regional Operations Managers (ROMs), Ground Operations, and external stakeholders \- ensuring critical processes are actioned, tracked, and closed on time. Beyond follow\-ups, you will dig into operational and compliance data across multiple datasets to surface trends, identify root causes for recurring issues, and turn insights into better process adherence and operational performance.


**About the role**


* Coordinate with regional and field teams to drive the timely closure of action items.
* Track compliance against defined processes and highlight gaps or delays proactively.
* Analyse operational and compliance data across multiple datasets to identify trends, surface insights, and support root\-cause analysis for recurring issues \- not just report numbers.
* Maintain trackers and status reports for ongoing initiatives.
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure accountability and adherence to timelines.
* Support governance of operational, compliance, and safety\-related programs.
* Escalate overdue actions and unresolved issues to the relevant stakeholders.
* Assist in the execution of cross\-functional projects and process improvement initiatives.


**About you**


* 1\-3 years of experience in operations, program management, compliance, or project coordination.
* Strong stakeholder management and excellent communication skills.
* High ownership and follow\-through \- you close loops and hold others accountable without being chased.
* Working knowledge of SQL and Power BI, plus solid Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* The ability to manage multiple trackers simultaneously and stay organised under competing priorities.
* A data\-driven approach to problem solving, with strong analytical skills \- able to deeply interpret data, run deep dives across multiple datasets, proactively spot trends, and drive root\-cause analysis (RCA).


**Nice to have**


* Experience in mobility, logistics, transportation, or fleet operations.
* Knowledge of or hands\-on experience with vibe coding and AI tools to automate processes and develop solutions.


*We recognise that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply \- we want to hear from you!*


**What we offer**


* Hybrid work model: a 5\-day work week with 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
* The opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling, tech\-driven environment shaping the future of mobility.
* High\-impact ownership of governance and compliance execution across operating regions.
* Broad cross\-functional exposure to Safety, Operations, Ground Operations, and external stakeholders.
* A learning and development budget and clear growth exposure into broader operations and program management roles.


**Why join Flix**



At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting\-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Retail Operations Manager
description:
About KSKT \& Kaze Living

KSKT AgroMart (Kisaan Se Kitchen Tak) is a technology and supply\-chain venture delivering naturally grown,

chemical\-free agro\-produce directly from trusted farms \- at fair prices for consumers and fair returns for farmers

practising Good Agricultural Practices.

Kaze Living is KSKT's premium gourmet grocery marketplace \- bringing fresh produce, artisan bakery, clean\-

label snacks, functional beverages, wellness essentials, and curated lifestyle products to discerning Delhi NCR

households. Together, KSKT and Kaze Living are building a modern retail ecosystem that combines quality,

transparency, and convenience across online and offline channels. www.ksktagromart.com

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Retail Operations Manager to drive day\-to\-day store operations and omnichannel executionacross our retail network. Based at the Gurgaon HO, this role requires frequent travel to stores and the mother DC to ensure smooth, consistent, and efficient operations on the ground.You will own the operational and P\&L performance of stores, lead store teams, and act as the key coordination link between stores and the central DC.

**Key Responsibilities**

Retail \& Store Operations

* Own end\-to\-end store operations across the network \- opening/closing procedures, stock availability, store hygiene, and operational compliance.
* Drive standardization of SOPs across stores and ensure consistent execution on the ground.
* Conduct regular store visits/audits to identify gaps and drive corrective action.
* Troubleshoot day\-to\-day operational issues and escalate/resolve as needed.

Omnichannel Operations

* Manage omnichannel fulfilment from stores (online orders, click\-and\-collect, quick\-commerce/last\-mile integrations as applicable).
* Ensure store\-level readiness (systems, inventory accuracy, packing/dispatch processes) to support online order fulfilment.
* Work with tech/ops teams to resolve omnichannel order and inventory sync issues.

P\&L \& Business Ownership

* Own the P\&L of assigned stores \- driving revenue, controlling costs (shrinkage, wastage, manpower,utilities), and improving store profitability.
* Track and review store\-level performance metrics (sales, footfall, conversion, basket size, wastage) and drive improvement plans.
* Plan and monitor budgets for store operating expenses.

Team Handling

* Lead, mentor and manage store managers and store teams across the network.
* Drive hiring, training, performance management, and retention of store\-level staff.
* Build a strong, accountable store operations culture with clear ownership at each level.

Coordination with Mother DC

* Act as the primary coordination point between stores and the mother DC for stock replenishment, indenting, and fill\-rate management.
* Work closely with the DC team to resolve supply gaps, damages/returns, and delivery scheduling issues.
* Improve store\-DC processes to reduce stock\-outs and improve inventory turnaround.

What We Are Looking For

* 4\-6 years of experience in retail operations, store operations, or omnichannel retail, ideally in a multi\-store environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning store\-level P\&L and driving profitability.
* Strong team handling and people management experience across front\-line and supervisory staff.
* Comfort with frequent travel between HO, stores, and the DC.
* Strong problem\-solving ability and comfort operating in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment.
* Good working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets for tracking performance and inventory.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills to work across stores, DC, and HO teams.

Pay: ₹60,000\.00 \- ₹80,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Production Manager

title: Senior Production Executive / Assistant Production Manager
description:
Assistant Production Manager / Production Manager – Food Manufacturing

**Industry:** Packaged Foods / FMCG Manufacturing

We are looking for a hands\-on production professional with relevant experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, cereals, snacks or similar food manufacturing**.

This role is not just for production supervision. The person should be capable of gradually taking ownership of **production planning, manpower, output, wastage, process control and daily factory execution**.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and execute **daily and weekly production plans** based on orders, inventory and dispatch requirements.
* Manage shop\-floor production across **mixing, dough preparation, forming, baking, cooling and packing** operations.
* Ensure achievement of **planned output, productivity and dispatch commitments**.
* Allocate manpower effectively across production lines and shifts.
* Monitor and control **yield, wastage, rework, breakage and process losses**.
* Track **plan vs actual production** and identify reasons for shortfalls.
* Monitor machine downtime, changeovers and production bottlenecks and take corrective action.
* Coordinate with **QC, Stores, Maintenance, Packing and Dispatch** teams for smooth production.
* Ensure availability of raw materials and packaging materials as per the production plan.
* Maintain process consistency for products such as **cookies, biscuits, rusk, cereals and related products**.
* Troubleshoot issues relating to **dough consistency, mixing, baking, colour, texture, moisture, crispness, breakage and product variation**.
* Support **new\-product trials and scale\-up from trial batches to commercial production**.
* Maintain proper batch records, production records, process parameters and shift handovers.
* Ensure compliance with factory hygiene, food\-safety, sanitation and production SOPs.
* Coordinate basic preventive maintenance and escalate machine issues on time.
* Prepare and maintain a simple **daily/weekly production MIS** covering:
* Production plan vs actual
* Output
* Wastage/yield
* Downtime
* Manpower
* Rework
* Key production issues
* Train and develop supervisors/operators so production does not depend on one individual.
* Be capable of independently managing routine production operations in the absence of the senior production head.

Candidate Profile

* **8–10 years** of relevant experience in food manufacturing.
* Strong preference for experience in **biscuits, cookies, bakery, rusk, cereals, snacks or similar dry\-food products**.
* Hands\-on knowledge of **mixing, forming, baking, cooling and packing processes**.
* Understanding of food\-production variables such as **temperature, time, moisture, dough consistency, formulation variation and process control**.
* Experience managing production workers and shop\-floor manpower.
* Comfortable working in a hands\-on manufacturing environment.
* Ability to analyse production problems rather than merely escalate them.
* Working knowledge of food hygiene, GMP and basic food\-safety systems.
* Ability to maintain production records and MIS.
* Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

B.Tech / B.Sc / Diploma in:  
**Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy/Food Processing,** or relevant manufcturing qualification.

Strong practical food\-production experience can compensate for formal qualification.

What We Will Evaluate in the Interview

Candidates should be prepared to discuss:

* Production volume and number of workers previously handled.
* Examples of reducing wastage or improving yield.
* How they handle production shortfalls and machine downtime.
* How they plan manpower across multiple SKUs.
* Troubleshooting of biscuit/cookie/bakery production problems.
* Production MIS and KPIs they have personally managed.
* Examples of new\-product commercial scale\-up.
* How they would independently run production if their reporting manager were absent.

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Do you have experience in formulating new products?

* Bachelor's (Required)
